decisionsTaken: One derived state axis `condition` keys the field and choice color families (color.field.{condition}.*, color.choice.{selection}.{condition}.*), resolved from the disabled, readonly and invalid props and pointer hover with a fixed precedence (disabled, readonly, invalid, [focus,] hover, default). The props stay separate (contract-guide: validation is not an interaction state); only the token lookup is flattened, as the approved field family already is.

A standalone text entry or radio group takes its accessible name from an optional, non-displayed label prop (the IconButton precedent); inside a Field the Field label wins. There is no visually hidden Field label: a control without a visible label is used without Field.
Controls perform no validation and expose invalid/required only; the visible error message and required marker belong to Field (catalog composition rule: controls are standalone, Field wraps them).

Same colors, border, radius, inline padding, typography and focus treatment as InputText of the same size; the block padding is derived (half of size.control minus one line) so a one-row textarea matches an InputText, with no new token.
resize vertical (default), auto (grows from rows to maxRows, default 3 and 8) or none; never inline resizing.
